profile.headline: Junior Software Engineer @ Spectrum Reach (via Brooksource)
profile.summary:
Software engineer with full stack experience in web development and a focus on user-centered design. Built responsive, SEO-friendly tools at MyFund using React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS, improving performance by 50%.

Strong communication and teamwork skills from working as a Pharmacy Technician at Publix. I am currently working as a Software Engineer at Spectrum Reach on the Appian Development team, developing tools that automate and optimize business processes to increase efficiency across the organization.

positions.description: Junior Software Engineer on the Appian team at Spectrum Reach.
positions.insights: Skills: Agile Methodologies · Testing · Appian · React.js · Software Development

positions.title: Pharmacy Technician
positions.locationName: Mint Hill, North Carolina, United States
positions.description:
As a Pharmacy Technician, I provide support in a fast-paced environment that requires strong attention to detail, time management, and clear communication to ensure patients receive safe and accurate care. I consistently prioritize tasks to manage high patient volume efficiently while maintaining a calm and positive attitude.

What sets me apart in this role is the focus I place on patient interaction. I take the time to listen, build trust, and create a welcoming environment, even during busy periods. Whether it’s resolving insurance issues, clarifying medication instructions, or simply offering reassurance, I aim to make every patient feel cared for and understood. I also take initiative in learning new processes to better support my team and improve workflow..
positions.insights: Skills: Analytical Skills · Communication · Data Entry · Organization Skills · Leadership · Teamwork · Attention to Detail

positions.title: Financial Chair
positions.locationName: Charlotte, North Carolina, United States · On-site

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked as part of a fast-paced startup team focused on building financial tools for working-class individuals in Nigeria to help them save and invest toward home ownership. I contributed primarily on the front end while also supporting backend development through API integrations.
	• Developed responsive, user-friendly interfaces using React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS, with a focus on accessibility and cross-device usability
	• Implemented SEO best practices including image optimization, structured metadata, site maps, and server-side rendering, resulting in a 50% improvement in overall site performance
	• Built out the front-end for two core features: Target Savings and Group Buy
	• Target Savings allowed users to set financial goals and track savings toward a specific property
	• Group Buy enabled collaborative investment by allowing users to create or join public or private groups for co-purchasing property
	• Ensured UI consistency across new features by aligning with existing design systems and brand styles, while enhancing layout intuitiveness
	• Collaborated closely with CTO to help plan feature flows and propose improvements during the development cycle
	• Implemented and tested RESTful API endpoints to connect front-end components with backend services
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Next.js · React.js · Search Engine Optimization (SEO) · Tailwind CSS · Django

positions.title: Hack@Davidson
positions.locationName: Davidson, North Carolina, United States · On-site
positions.description: For the Hack@Davidson, my team and I developed a platform which focuses on an AI system that transforms litter management by enabling efficient reporting, interactive user engagement, and data-driven insights. This platform was built with HTML and CSS and ChatGPT.
positions.insights: Skills: Analytical Skills · CSS · Computer Science · Teamwork · ChatGPT · HTML

positions.title: Volunteer
positions.locationName: Charlotte, North Carolina, United States · On-site
positions.description: I volunteered through Raising Smart Girls at Bruns Elementary, where I guided students through modules related to Science, Technology, Engineering, and Math. During one activity, we taught students how to create their own circuits using a picture frame. I ensured that the students had a clean workspace, assisted them in adjusting their circuits, and helped them decorate their picture frames.

projects.title: MedTranslate
projects.description: MedTranslate is a full-stack web development project I am currently working on, designed to serve as a reliable and accurate medical translation tool for healthcare settings. Inspired by my experience as a Pharmacy Technician, I saw firsthand how challenging it can be to communicate critical medical instructions or side effects across language barriers. This application aims to support both patients and healthcare professionals by improving understanding and ensuring clear, accurate communication in clinical environments.
